name: Bost slope formalism for Euclidean lattices
function_signature: (Euclidean lattice / Hermitian bundle over Spec Z) → (slope, canonical Harder–Narasimhan filtration)
description: An adaptation of the Arakelov-geometric slope and Harder–Narasimhan filtration formalism to Euclidean lattices, assigning a slope and a canonical destabilizing filtration to each Hermitian bundle over Spec Z.

name: Reverse-Minkowski / transference inequalities for lattices
description: Quantitative inequalities relating the covering radius, smoothing parameter, and theta function of a Euclidean lattice and its dual, proved by Banaszczyk, Regev, and Stephens-Davidowitz.

name: Equidistribution of Fekete points via pluripotential theory
description: Energy-minimizing Fekete configurations on a compact complex manifold equidistribute toward the equilibrium measure of the associated weighted potential as the number of points grows, proved by Berman, Boucksom, and Witt Nyström.

name: Coulomb gas / determinantal pluripotential point process
description: A point process weighting configurations by an exponential of a pairwise logarithmic-energy functional whose macroscopic large-deviation limit is an equilibrium pluripotential (Monge–Ampère) measure.

name: Asymptotic normality of eigenvectors of random regular graphs
description: The entries of eigenvectors of a uniformly random d-regular graph become jointly Gaussian (fully delocalized) in the large-vertex limit, proved by Backhausz and Szegedy.

name: Typical processes on the d-regular tree (factor-of-i.i.d. method)
function_signature: (eigenvector of random regular graph) → (invariant typical process on the infinite d-regular tree)
description: Analyzing eigenvectors of random regular graphs via invariant typical processes (factors of i.i.d.) on the infinite d-regular tree together with entropy inequalities.

name: Coarse embeddability of non-exact groups into Hilbert space
description: There exist finitely generated groups that are not exact (lack property A) yet admit a coarse embedding into Hilbert space, separating the two coarse-geometric properties, due to Arzhantseva–Guentner–Osajda–Špakula.

name: Property A (coarse amenability)
description: A coarse amenability condition on a bounded-geometry metric space requiring uniformly large controlled-boundary finite subsets, equivalent for groups to exactness of the reduced group C*-algebra.

name: Crystalline companions theorem
description: For a smooth variety over a finite field, every ℓ-adic lisse sheaf in a compatible system admits ℓ'-adic and crystalline (overconvergent F-isocrystal) companions with matching Frobenius characteristic polynomials, established by Deligne, Drinfeld, L. Lafforgue, and Abe.

name: Abe's p-adic Langlands correspondence for function fields
description: A bijection, compatible with L. Lafforgue's ℓ-adic correspondence, between overconvergent F-isocrystals and automorphic forms over a function field, realizing crystalline companions, proved by T. Abe.

name: Furstenberg-boundary criterion for C*-simplicity
description: A discrete group has a simple reduced C*-algebra if and only if its action on its Furstenberg boundary is topologically free, equivalently it has no nontrivial amenable normal subgroup, proved by Kalantar–Kennedy and Breuillard–Kalantar–Kennedy–Ozawa.

name: C*-simplicity
description: The property of a discrete group that its reduced group C*-algebra is simple, having no nontrivial closed two-sided ideals.

name: Boundedness of singular Fano varieties (BAB conjecture)
description: For each dimension d and ε>0 the ε-log-canonical Fano varieties of dimension d form a bounded family, proved by Birkar.

name: Theory of complements (boundedness of complements)
function_signature: (log Fano pair) → (bounded index n-complement)
description: A birational-geometry method bounding the index of n-complements of log Fano pairs, used by Birkar to establish boundedness of Fano families.

name: Moduli of stable (KSBA) varieties of general type
description: Families of higher-dimensional varieties of general type admit a separated proper moduli space of stable (semi-log-canonical, ample canonical) objects, generalizing Deligne–Mumford stable reduction, due to Kollár and Hacon–McKernan–Xu.

name: Higher Teichmüller theory
description: The study of connected components of the character variety of a surface group into a higher-rank semisimple Lie group consisting entirely of discrete faithful representations, generalizing Teichmüller space.

name: Anosov representation
description: A representation of a hyperbolic group into a semisimple Lie group whose flat bundle admits a continuous equivariant transverse limit map with uniform contraction (dominated splitting).

name: HOMFLY polynomial from Hilbert schemes of a plane curve singularity
description: The HOMFLY polynomial of the link of a plane curve singularity equals the generating series of Euler characteristics of Hilbert schemes of points on the curve, conjectured by Oblomkov–Rasmussen–Shende and proved by Maulik.

name: Oblomkov–Shende / Maulik conjecture
description: The conjectural identity equating the HOMFLY invariant of a singularity link with a Hilbert-scheme generating function, refined by the perverse filtration.

name: Maximum of the Riemann zeta function in short intervals
description: The maximum of |ζ(1/2+it)| over a typical short interval of length ~2π near height T is governed to leading order by log-correlated field / branching random walk statistics, established by Najnudel and Arguin et al.

name: Log-correlated field / branching random walk heuristic for zeta
function_signature: (log|ζ| on the critical line) → (extreme-value statistics via branching random walk)
description: Modeling the local behaviour of log|ζ| on the critical line by a logarithmically correlated Gaussian field to transfer extreme-value results from branching random walks (Fyodorov–Hiary–Keating).

name: Sharpness of the phase transition (Duminil-Copin–Raoufi–Tassion)
description: For a broad class of percolation and Ising-type models the phase transition is sharp, with exponential decay of correlations throughout the subcritical regime, proved by Duminil-Copin, Raoufi, and Tassion.

name: OSSS inequality method for sharp thresholds
function_signature: (monotone Boolean function / percolation event) → (differential inequality on crossing probabilities)
description: Using the O'Donnell–Saks–Schramm–Servedio decision-tree inequality to derive differential inequalities on percolation probabilities yielding sharp phase transitions.

name: Disproof of the Triangulation Conjecture
description: For every dimension n ≥ 5 there exist closed topological manifolds admitting no triangulation, proved by Manolescu via Pin(2)-equivariant Seiberg–Witten Floer homology.

name: Pin(2)-equivariant Seiberg–Witten Floer homology (Manolescu invariants)
function_signature: (homology 3-sphere) → (invariants (α,β,γ) obstructing homology cobordism)
description: A Pin(2)-equivariant Seiberg–Witten Floer homology of homology 3-spheres producing invariants that obstruct order-two elements of the homology cobordism group with wrong Rokhlin invariant.

name: Homological stability for Hurwitz spaces (Cohen–Lenstra over function fields)
description: Hurwitz moduli spaces of branched covers exhibit homological stability, implying Cohen–Lenstra-type predictions for class groups of quadratic function fields over finite fields in the large-q limit, due to Ellenberg–Venkatesh–Westerland.

name: Homological stability method (scanning / group completion)
function_signature: (sequence of moduli/configuration spaces) → (stabilized homology groups)
description: A topological method establishing that the homology of a sequence of moduli or configuration spaces stabilizes, via arc complexes and scanning/group-completion arguments.

name: Infinitely many minimal hypersurfaces (Yau's conjecture, dim 3–7)
description: Every closed Riemannian manifold of dimension between 3 and 7 contains infinitely many closed embedded minimal hypersurfaces, proved by Marques–Neves and Song.

name: Almgren–Pitts min-max theory / volume spectrum Weyl law
function_signature: (multiparameter sweepout of a manifold) → (minimal hypersurface critical points with Weyl-law widths)
description: A variational min-max scheme producing minimal hypersurfaces as critical points of the area functional over multiparameter sweepouts, with a Weyl-type asymptotic law for the widths.

name: Herman's positive metric entropy conjecture
description: The conjecture that arbitrarily close to integrable systems or near an elliptic fixed point there exist smooth area-preserving diffeomorphisms with positive metric (Kolmogorov–Sinai) entropy.

name: Berger–Turaev theorem (positive metric entropy)
description: Any area-preserving C^r diffeomorphism of a surface with an elliptic fixed point can be C^r-perturbed to one with a chaotic island of positive metric entropy, proving Herman's conjecture, due to Berger and Turaev.

name: Asymptotic stability of the Lamb–Oseen vortex
description: The two-dimensional Lamb–Oseen vortex is asymptotically stable for the Navier–Stokes equations uniformly in viscosity, with enhanced inviscid damping rates, proved by Li–Wei–Zhang.

name: Pseudospectral / enhanced-dissipation estimates
function_signature: (linearized non-self-adjoint operator) → (resolvent bounds controlling transient growth)
description: Using pseudospectral resolvent bounds on the linearized non-self-adjoint operator together with enhanced dissipation to control transient growth and prove stability of vortices.

name: C^∞ closing lemma (Asaoka–Irie)
description: For Hamiltonian and Reeb flows on surfaces and 3-manifolds, periodic orbits are C^∞-dense, proving a smooth closing lemma in these settings, due to Asaoka and Irie.

name: Embedded contact homology spectral invariants (Weyl law)
function_signature: (contact 3-manifold / area-preserving surface map) → (spectral invariants with Weyl-law asymptotics)
description: Spectral invariants from embedded contact homology whose asymptotics obey a Weyl law recovering contact volume, used to force creation and density of periodic Reeb orbits.

name: Resolvent estimates for non-self-adjoint semiclassical operators
description: Sharp bounds on the resolvent and localization of the pseudospectrum for classes of non-self-adjoint semiclassical pseudodifferential operators, governed by subprincipal-symbol bracket conditions, due to Dencker–Sjöstrand–Zworski.

name: Definability of period maps
description: Any period map of an admissible polarized variation of mixed Hodge structure is definable in the o-minimal structure R_an,exp, proved by Bakker–Brunebarbe–Klingler–Tsimerman.

name: Definable Chow / o-minimal GAGA (Peterzil–Starchenko)
function_signature: (definable complex analytic subset of an algebraic variety) → (algebraic subvariety)
description: A transfer principle of Peterzil–Starchenko stating that a definable complex analytic subset of an algebraic variety is algebraic, used to deduce algebraicity from definable analytic statements.

name: Algebraicity of Hodge loci (via o-minimality)
description: The Hodge locus in a family is an algebraic subvariety, reproved by Bakker–Klingler–Tsimerman using definable Chow / o-minimal GAGA (the theorem of Cattani–Deligne–Kaplan).

name: Maximal isotopy & transverse singular foliation
description: For a surface homeomorphism isotopic to the identity, a maximal identity isotopy carries a transverse singular foliation whose leaves encode the dynamics.

name: Le Calvez–Tal forcing theory
function_signature: (surface homeomorphism with maximal isotopy) → (periodic orbits / positive topological entropy)
description: A forcing method of Le Calvez and Tal using transverse trajectories in a maximal singular foliation to detect periodic orbits and positive topological entropy of surface homeomorphisms.

name: Nodal-set volume estimates (Yau's nodal conjecture)
description: The (n−1)-Hausdorff measure of the nodal set of a Laplace eigenfunction with eigenvalue λ on a compact analytic manifold is bounded above and below by polynomial powers of √λ, proved by Logunov–Malinnikova.

name: Doubling index / frequency-function method
function_signature: (harmonic / eigenfunction) → (local growth bounds via doubling index)
description: A combinatorial-analytic technique controlling the local growth (doubling index) of harmonic or eigenfunctions via almost-monotonicity and cube subdivision to bound nodal-set volume.

name: Ratner-type rigidity in infinite-volume hyperbolic manifolds
description: Classification and equidistribution of orbit closures of unipotent and horospherical flows on geometrically finite infinite-volume hyperbolic manifolds, due to McMullen, Mohammadi, and Oh.

name: Quantitative inverse theorem for the Gowers norms
description: A function with non-negligible U^{s+1} Gowers norm correlates with a nilsequence of bounded complexity, with polynomial effective bounds, proved by F. Manners.

name: Higher-order Fourier analysis (inverse-theorem method)
function_signature: (function with large Gowers norm) → (correlating degree-s nilsequence)
description: Decomposing functions via degree-s nilsequences and iterating Cauchy–Schwarz and equidistribution on nilmanifolds to invert the Gowers norms.

name: Reconstruction of a variety from its Zariski topology
description: A normal projective variety of dimension ≥ 2 over an algebraically closed field is determined, as a scheme, by the homeomorphism type of its underlying Zariski topological space, due to Kollár (and Lieblich–Olsson).

name: Zagier's polylogarithm conjecture
description: The conjecture that the value ζ_F(n) of a number field is expressible via a regulator determinant of values of the n-th polylogarithm on F-points.

name: Goncharov–Rudenko theorem on ζ_F(4)
description: Zagier's conjecture holds in weight 4, expressing ζ_F(4) via the tetralogarithm, proved by Goncharov–Rudenko using the weight-4 polylogarithmic motivic complex and a new functional equation.

name: Goncharov motivic polylogarithm complexes
description: A family of complexes built from polylogarithmic groups conjecturally computing motivic cohomology and underlying Zagier's conjecture.

name: Motivic correlators / cluster polylogarithm method
function_signature: (cluster structure of M_{0,n}) → (polylogarithm functional equations / cohomology classes)
description: Using Goncharov's motivic correlators and the cluster variety structure of M_{0,n} to construct polylogarithm functional equations realizing required cohomology classes.

name: Fractal uncertainty principle
description: The principle that a function and its Fourier transform cannot both concentrate on a fractal (porous, Ahlfors–David regular) set, quantified by a power-saving operator-norm bound, due to Bourgain–Dyatlov and Dyatlov–Jin–Nonnenmacher.

name: Essential spectral gap via fractal uncertainty
description: On convex co-compact hyperbolic surfaces the fractal uncertainty principle yields an essential spectral gap (resonance-free strip) depending only on the limit-set dimension, due to Bourgain–Dyatlov and Dyatlov–Zahl.

name: Finiteness of totally geodesic subvarieties in moduli of curves
description: There are only finitely many primitive totally geodesic subvarieties of dimension ≥ 2 in strata of translation surfaces / moduli of Riemann surfaces, proved by Eskin–McMullen–Mukamel–Wright.

name: Asymptotic counting of minimal surfaces in hyperbolic 3-manifolds
description: The number of closed minimal surfaces of bounded genus in a closed hyperbolic 3-manifold grows with an exponential asymptotic analogous to the prime geodesic theorem, due to Calegari–Marques–Neves.

name: Equidistribution of minimal surfaces (frame-flow mixing)
function_signature: (random minimal surface in a hyperbolic 3-manifold) → (equidistribution in the Grassmann bundle)
description: Proving randomly chosen minimal surfaces equidistribute in the Grassmann bundle via exponential mixing of the frame/geodesic flow, to deduce asymptotic counting.

name: Roelcke precompact Polish group
description: A topological group precompact for the lower (Roelcke) uniformity; these arise as automorphism groups of ℵ₀-categorical structures.

name: Property (T) for Roelcke-precompact Polish groups
description: Large classes of Roelcke-precompact Polish groups, such as automorphism groups of homogeneous structures, satisfy a continuous-logic version of Kazhdan's property (T), proved by Ibarlucía.

name: Classification of NIP fields (Johnson's theorem)
description: Every infinite NIP field is separably closed, real closed, or admits a nontrivial henselian valuation, confirming Shelah's conjecture in the dp-finite case, proved by W. Johnson.

name: NIP (dependent theory)
description: A first-order theory has the Non-Independence Property if no formula has the independence property, equivalently every formula has finite VC dimension.

name: dp-rank / dp-finiteness analysis of valued fields
function_signature: (NIP field) → (canonical henselian valuation)
description: A method classifying NIP fields by bounding dp-rank and reconstructing a canonical henselian valuation from the model-theoretic structure.

name: High-dimensional expanders
description: Higher-dimensional analogues of expander graphs: bounded-degree simplicial complexes exhibiting strong spectral, coboundary, or topological expansion in all dimensions.

name: Local spectral expansion / coboundary expansion
function_signature: (simplicial complex with expanding links) → (global spectral / coboundary expansion)
description: A bootstrapping criterion deriving global expansion of a simplicial complex from expansion of all of its vertex links.

name: Metric John theorem (Naor)
description: A nonlinear analogue of John's ellipsoid theorem giving average-distortion bounds for embeddings of metric spaces, controlled by nonlinear spectral gaps, due to A. Naor.

name: Nonlinear spectral gap
description: A generalization of the spectral gap of a graph to maps into nonlinear metric spaces, quantifying the obstruction to low-distortion embeddings.

name: Local marked length spectrum rigidity
description: On a closed negatively curved (Anosov) manifold the marked length spectrum locally determines the metric up to isometry in all dimensions, proved by Guillarmou–Lefeuvre.

name: Microlocal geodesic X-ray transform method
function_signature: (Anosov metric perturbation) → (rigidity via elliptic normal operator inversion)
description: Using the geodesic X-ray transform, its normal operator as an elliptic pseudodifferential operator, and microlocal analysis to prove length-spectrum rigidity.

name: Finite-time implosion for compressible fluids and NLS
description: Construction of smooth solutions of the compressible Euler/Navier–Stokes equations and energy-supercritical NLS developing self-similar implosion singularities in finite time, due to Merle–Raphaël–Rodnianski–Szeftel.

name: Self-similar imploding profile construction
function_signature: (nonlinear PDE) → (finite-time singularity via stable self-similar profile)
description: Building finite-time singularities via smooth self-similar profile solutions and proving their nonlinear stability under perturbation.

name: Kannan–Lovász–Simonovits (KLS) conjecture
description: The conjecture that the Cheeger isoperimetric constant of an isotropic log-concave probability measure is bounded below by a universal dimension-independent constant.

name: Stochastic localization (Eldan)
function_signature: (log-concave measure) → (martingale localization into near-Gaussians)
description: A measure-valued martingale process gradually localizing a log-concave measure into Gaussians, used by Eldan and Y. Chen to obtain near-optimal bounds toward the KLS conjecture.

name: Binary additive problems for polynomials over finite fields
description: Asymptotic counts for twin-prime and Goldbach-type additive problems over F_q[t] in the large-q regime, due to Sawin–Shusterman.

name: Sheaf-theoretic counting over function fields
function_signature: (additive prime problem over F_q[t]) → (compactly-supported étale cohomology computation)
description: Translating additive prime problems over F_q[t] into computations of compactly-supported étale cohomology and bounding Betti numbers.

name: Crystalline measure
description: A tempered measure on Euclidean space whose support and the support of whose Fourier transform are both locally finite (discrete), generalizing Poisson summation and quasicrystals, studied by Kurasov–Olevskii, Sarnak, and Viazovska.

name: K(π,1) conjecture for affine Artin groups
description: The Salvetti complex of an affine Coxeter system is aspherical, so its quotient is a classifying space, proving the K(π,1) conjecture for affine Artin groups, due to Paolini–Salvetti.

name: Dual braid monoid / Garside structure method
function_signature: (Artin group) → (asphericity via Garside structure and discrete Morse theory)
description: Establishing asphericity via Garside-theoretic structures on the dual braid monoid and the associated noncrossing-partition order complex with discrete Morse theory.

name: Improved bounds for sets without three-term arithmetic progressions
description: Improved upper bounds on subsets of {1,...,N} and of F_q^n with no nontrivial 3-term AP, including the cap-set polynomial-method bound and the Bloom–Sisask logarithmic improvement, due to Bloom–Sisask, Croot–Lev–Pach, and Ellenberg–Gijswijt.

name: Slice rank / polynomial method (cap sets)
function_signature: (extremal set) → (slice-rank upper bound via low-degree polynomials)
description: Bounding extremal set sizes by upper-bounding the slice rank of an associated diagonal multilinear tensor via low-degree polynomials, due to Croot–Lev–Pach and Ellenberg–Gijswijt.

name: Unbounded denominators conjecture
description: A modular form on a finite-index subgroup of SL₂(Z) whose q-expansion has bounded denominators is a modular form for a congruence subgroup, with a vector-valued generalization, proved by Calegari–Dimitrov–Tang.

name: Arithmetic holonomicity bound
function_signature: (space of holonomic power series with integrality) → (dimension bound)
description: A potential-theoretic and transcendence inequality bounding the dimension of a space of holonomic power series with arithmetic integrality, combined with Nevanlinna theory.

name: Fluctuation theory for the Boltzmann–Grad limit
description: Rigorous derivation, in the Boltzmann–Grad limit, of fluctuation and large-deviation corrections to the Boltzmann equation from a hard-sphere system, extending Lanford's theorem, due to Bodineau–Gallagher–Saint-Raymond–Simonella.

name: BBGKY hierarchy / cumulant expansion for fluctuations
function_signature: (hard-sphere correlation functions) → (controlled fluctuations around the Boltzmann limit)
description: Expanding correlations of a hard-sphere system via the BBGKY hierarchy and cluster/cumulant expansions to control fluctuations around the Boltzmann limit.

name: Pointwise ergodic theorems along polynomial sequences
description: Pointwise convergence of ergodic averages along sparse and polynomial sequences, via oscillation and variation estimates, due to J. Bourgain.

name: Direct summand conjecture
description: For a finite extension of a regular Noetherian ring, the smaller ring is a direct summand as a module, proved in mixed characteristic by André and Bhatt.

name: Perfectoid / almost-mathematics method
function_signature: (mixed-characteristic commutative algebra problem) → (perfectoid reduction via tilting)
description: Reducing problems in mixed-characteristic commutative algebra to perfectoid algebras and tilting, controlling errors via Faltings's almost mathematics.

name: Strong convergence of spectra of random permutation matrices
description: A sum of independent uniformly random permutation matrices, restricted to the orthogonal complement of the trivial representation, has operator norm converging to the spectral radius, giving almost-Ramanujan random regular graphs, proved by Bordenave–Collins.

name: Strong asymptotic freeness / non-backtracking operator method
function_signature: (family of random matrices) → (operator-norm convergence to free limit)
description: Establishing strong (operator-norm) convergence to free limits via the non-backtracking (Ihara–Bass) operator and matched-moment polynomial bounds.

name: MIP* = RE
description: The class of languages decidable by multiprover interactive proofs with entangled (quantum) provers equals the recursively enumerable languages, proved by Ji–Natarajan–Vidick–Wright–Yuen.

name: Refutation of the Connes embedding conjecture
description: The conjecture that every separable II₁ factor embeds into an ultrapower of the hyperfinite II₁ factor, shown false as a consequence of MIP* = RE.

name: Non-simplicity of the group of area-preserving homeomorphisms of S²
description: The group of area- and orientation-preserving homeomorphisms of the 2-sphere is not simple, via unbounded quasimorphisms built from spectral invariants, due to Cristofaro-Gardiner–Humilière–Seyfaddini.

name: Periodic Floer homology spectral invariants
description: Sequences of spectral invariants of area-preserving surface maps defined via periodic Floer homology, assembling into unbounded quasimorphisms and a Calabi homogenization.

name: Pointwise convergence for the Schrödinger equation (Carleson's problem)
description: The free Schrödinger evolution of an H^s(ℝⁿ) datum converges pointwise a.e. to the datum iff s ≥ n/(2(n+1)), resolving Carleson's problem, due to Du–Zhang.

name: Polynomial partitioning / decoupling for the Schrödinger maximal operator
function_signature: (Schrödinger maximal operator) → (sharp L^2 bound)
description: Bounding the Schrödinger maximal operator via broad–narrow analysis, polynomial partitioning, and ℓ²-decoupling with weighted fractal restriction estimates.

name: Well-ordering of exponential growth rates of hyperbolic groups
description: The set of exponential growth rates of finitely generated subgroups of a hyperbolic group is well-ordered, with growth rates achieved and algebraic, proved by Fujiwara–Sela.

name: Asperó–Schindler theorem (MM⁺⁺ implies (∗))
description: Martin's Maximum⁺⁺ implies Woodin's axiom (∗), unifying two strong forcing axioms and settling the continuum at ℵ₂ under them, proved by Asperó–Schindler.

name: Pmax / stationary-tower forcing
function_signature: (large-cardinal model) → (canonical model of a strong forcing axiom)
description: Set-theoretic forcing constructions (Pmax, stationary tower) producing canonical models of strong forcing axioms.

name: Classification of symmetric tensor categories in positive characteristic
description: Incompressibility and classification results for symmetric tensor categories of moderate growth over a field of characteristic p, with the Verlinde categories as universal fibers, due to Coulembier–Etingof–Ostrik.

name: Verlinde category Ver_p
description: The semisimplification of the category of representations of Z/p in characteristic p, the universal incompressible target for symmetric tensor categories of moderate growth.

name: Non-uniqueness of Leray–Hopf solutions to forced Navier–Stokes
description: There exist forcing terms for which the 3D Navier–Stokes equations admit two distinct Leray–Hopf weak solutions, exhibiting non-uniqueness in the energy class, due to Albritton–Brué–Colombo.

name: Unstable self-similar profile / spectral instability method
function_signature: (linearly unstable self-similar background) → (bifurcated second solution along an unstable eigenmode)
description: Constructing two solutions by exhibiting a linearly unstable self-similar background and bifurcating a second trajectory along an unstable eigenmode.

name: Twisted Lang–Weil estimate
description: A point-count estimate for definable sets twisted by a Frobenius-type correspondence, quantifying equidistribution, with applications to difference algebra and pseudofinite fields, due to Hrushovski–Shuddhodan–Varshavsky.

name: Rotational invariance of critical planar percolation
description: The scaling limit of critical Bernoulli percolation on a class of planar lattices is rotationally invariant, a step toward full conformal invariance, due to Duminil-Copin et al.

name: RSW / star-triangle (Yang–Baxter) transformation method
function_signature: (planar lattice percolation) → (transported crossing events under lattice deformation)
description: Using Russo–Seymour–Welsh box-crossing estimates with star-triangle (Yang–Baxter) transformations to deform lattices and transport crossing events, yielding rotational invariance.
